description: Lumora resource definitions. Used by Harvestable nodes, Inventory, Workbench, and Player House.

wood.name: Verdant Wood
wood.description: Common timber from the meadow. Basic building material.

stone.name: Ruin Stone
stone.description: Salvaged from old tilework and ruins. Sturdy but heavy.

fiber.name: Sky Fiber
fiber.description: Tough vines and grass. Used for ropes, cloth, and basic tools.

crystal_shard.name: Verdant Crystal Shard
crystal_shard.description: Glowing fragments that leak from the world. Valuable and reactive.

echo_fragment.name: Echo Fragment
echo_fragment.description: Resonant pieces of the world’s memory. Used in advanced crafting and story progression.

meat.name: Wisp Meat
meat.description: From defeated enemies. Perishable but nourishing.

herb.name: Patch Herb
herb.description: Common medicinal plant. Base for teas and stews.
